doc: Two armed rifle squads on HOLD, line formation, 30 m apart: the mirror duel of U1 04 §1.3. Under nearest against nearest both are wiped together (lockstep volleys spread fire over all eight). With one side on the focus policy (sw-pd2l.4) it kills first and the duel turns: survivors are 8 minus the other side's kills. Gate: 6-0 for the focus side, from either side.

focus_a.doc: Squad a uses the focus targeting policy; b keeps nearest.

focus_b.doc: Squad b uses the focus targeting policy; a keeps nearest (the side swap).

probes.doc: nearest against nearest: a mutual wipe (0-0).
